paragraphs: The X1 xDrive25e joined the X1 range in 2019 as a plug-in hybrid variant, pairing a 1.5-litre B38 three-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor and a 14.2kWh battery, offering an electric-only range of 48-55 miles per official spec. The model spans two generations: the F48 (2019–2022) and the current U11 (2022–present). Both use essentially the same powertrain architecture — the B38 petrol unit paired with an electric motor — though the newer generation benefits from updated battery and hybrid system refinements. B-series engines from this era are generally regarded as reliable, with no widely-reported major failure pattern across the range. Knowing which generation yours is matters for parts compatibility and battery system matching, which is why we always confirm your exact spec by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 xDrive25e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
